source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Eligibility to fight: the unit has not been chosen to fight yet in this phase, and it is engaged, was engaged as the step opened, or charged this turn. The players loop through two steps until every eligible unit has been chosen and has resolved its attacks. Step 1, Fights First: the active player begins, then the players alternate, each choosing one of their own eligible Fights First units, which is then chosen to fight. If the player due to choose cannot: when no eligible Fights First unit is left anywhere, move to step 2 and that same player makes the next choice there; in any other case the opponent makes the next choice. Step 2, Remaining Combats: whoever advanced the sequence into this step begins, then the players alternate, each choosing any one of their own eligible units. If the player due to choose cannot: when no eligible unit is left anywhere, the Fight step is over; in any other case the opponent makes the next choice. After each fight resolved in step 2, go back to step 1 if any Fights First unit has become eligible; on that return, the non-active player makes the first choice. A unit chosen to fight resolves one fight type it qualifies for, either Normal Fight, Overrun Fight or a type defined elsewhere. Whenever the choice comes back to a player whose eligible units are all over 5" from every enemy unit, that player may pass it back to the opponent; the step ends if the players pass one straight after the other, or if one passes when the opponent has no eligible unit left. Designer’s note: this lets a player whose targets were all destroyed wait in case an enemy unit later piles in close enough to attack. Example: Fights First units go before all others; a **MONSTER** destroys a **TRANSPORT**, whose passengers make an emergency disembark move and end unengaged; as the other side has no Fights First unit, the first player picks another of theirs that started the step in engagement with the **TRANSPORT**, which piles in, makes an overrun fight and destroys two models; the opposing unit then fights back without inflicting damage.

interpretation.question: Who selects first when returning from Remaining Combats to Fights First?
